final_text: All 23 tests pass. The fix was changing `args = self.args` to `args = self.vertices` on line 423 of `polygon.py`. This ensures that `second_moment_of_area` iterates over actual vertex points (via the `.vertices` property) rather than constructor arguments (`.args`), which for `RegularPolygon` are `(center, radius, n, angle)` instead of the vertex `Point` objects.
